title: Add an admin list of recent orders
description: The admin dashboard needs the latest orders. Adds GET /api/admin/orders with the 50 newest orders and their customer, with tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: The route only checks that someone is signed in, not that they are an admin, so any customer can list every customer's orders and email addresses.
